thread:
ashley: Heads-up — prepping EU->US cutover for runtime/console/router tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need a short pin window and explicit rollback triggers. Who's owning the pin list?
simon: I can own pinning for runtime and router. Will need API schema freeze and console coordinate.
nina: Console can be pinned. Are we pinning API to v2026-03-18 or rolling forward to v2026-03-20?
kevin: Recommend pin API=v2026-03-20 because it contains the auth fix. Runtime has a kernel batching change that's risky; we should skip that for this wave.
ashley: OK pin API=v2026-03-20, runtime=rb-3.1.4 (no kernel change), router=stable-7. Should we do a tiny canary (5%) first?
simon: Yes 5% canary in EU for 10m, monitor latency & 5xx. If steady, ramp to 50% for 15m then full.
deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled wave 'eu-us-cutover-1780011223' at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. Canary targets: runtime=5% EU, router=5% EU. To abort: /deploybot abort <wave> or mark manual rollback.
oncall-sre: I will watch infra metrics. Put these alerts: runtime_p50>80ms for 5m, router_5xx_rate>0.5% for 5m, api_5xx>0.2% for 3m.
nina: Console team: hold on DB migration until after full ramp. We tested locally; ops approves. Will delay by 30m.
kevin: Noted. We'll plan the migration slot +30m. Also, fallback plan: if runtime latency spikes, redeploy runtime with kernel backout tag rb-3.1.3 immediately.
ashley: Rollback decision tree: — Canary fail -> pin traffic back to previous runtime + unroll changes; — Router fail -> route back to stable path; — API 5xx -> roll back API version. We need clear owners in rotation.
simon: @nina @kevin you're owners for app-level pins. oncall-sre please initiate rollback if thresholds met. I'll handle pin/unpin ops and coord with deploybot.
deploybot: Note: commands ahead
```
/deploybot start eu-us-cutover-1780011223 --canary 5 --canary-duration 10m
/deploybot ramp eu-us-cutover-1780011223 --to 50 --duration 15m
/deploybot commit eu-us-cutover-1780011223
```
oncall-sre: I'll be at my desk. Set pager if router_5xx spike happens. :rotating_light: 
ashley: Final ask: update release notes with pinned versions and migration delay. I'll post final signoff at 01:30 UTC. Thanks :thumbsup:
